title: Add comprehensive component demonstrations including Dashboard category to playground
body:
Created 23 new demonstration scenarios across 6 new categories to showcase component capabilities and usage patterns. Total playground demos increased from 11 to 34. ## Changes ### New Categories & Demos - **Dashboards** (3): Analytics dashboard, E-commerce dashboard, Project management dashboard - **Basic** (4): Typography, image gallery, icon showcase, separator usage - **Feedback** (3): Loading spinners, progress bars, skeleton screens - **Disclosure** (2): Accordion FAQ, collapsible sections - **Forms** (5 new): Form controls (checkbox/radio/switch/slider), date pickers, file upload, OTP input, toggles - **Data Display** (6 new): Alert variants, badges, avatars, lists, markdown, tree hierarchy - **Complex** (3 new): Carousel, timeline, basic table ### File Structure ``` apps/playground/src/data/examples/ ├── dashboards/ # New category - beautiful dashboard demos ├── basic/ # New category ├── feedback/ # New category ├── disclosure/ # New category ├── forms/ # Enhanced with 5 new demos ├── data-display/ # Enhanced with 6 new demos ├── complex/ # Enhanced with 3 new demos ├── dashboards.ts # New registry ├── basic.ts # New registry ├── feedback.ts # New registry ├── disclosure.ts # New registry └── examples.ts # Updated with new categories ``` ## Screenshots **Dashboards Category** **Analytics Dashboard** **E-Commerce Dashboard** **Category Navigation** **Basic Components Category** **Typography Demo** **Feedback Components** **Timeline Component** ## Design Principles Each demo follows: - **Schema-first**: Pure JSON, zero manual React code - **Tailwind-native**: Demonstrates className customization - **Production-ready**: Real-world usage patterns - **Comprehensive**: Covers primary component variants and states ## Dashboard Highlights The new Dashboard category showcases: - **Modern Gradients**: Beautiful color schemes (blue/slate, purple/pink/orange, dark theme) - **Rich Components**: KPI cards, data tables, chart placeholders, activity feeds, progress bars, timelines - **Professional Layouts**: Production-ready dashboard structures for analytics, e-commerce, and project management - **Visual Excellence**: Demonstrates the full power of Tailwind CSS with Object UI's schema-driven approach
Original prompt > 按照最新的规范考虑每一个组件设计合适的演示场景放在playground中
